verdict.rationale: GitHub Mobile's own page says users can ask Copilot, in natural language, for insights into public and private repositories and to open a new pull request, which matches the story directly. Copilot code review on mobile also analyzes existing pull requests. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on the mobile chat experience beyond marketing copy, and independent or hands-on corroboration of conversational repo/PR insights on mobile.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can converse with an AI agent in natural language to get insights into repositories and open pull requests

citations.quote: Ask Copilot to break down complex coding concepts, guide you through unfamiliar codebases, provide insights into both public and your private repositories, and open a new pull request – all in natural language.
Let Copilot code review analyze your pull requests and suggest improvements right from your phone.
GitHub Copilot on GitHub.com can answer questions about your repositories, plan and make changes, review pull requests, and automate repository tasks.
